item.title: Version 3.1.0
item.description:
CedarLogic now is able to work on machines without 3D acceleration (vms / older computers). We now fall back to drawing with the CPU which is slower but still works.

Two windows issues are now fixed as well; the toolbar icons were sometimes rendering with the wrong color making them hard to read and the export dialog could print weird characters in the dialog due to an issue in the build process.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/taciturnaxolotl/CedarLogic/compare/v3.0.2...v3.1.0
